pages.text: A sandstone plaza 480 blocks from where you first appeared: a nexus, pylons, gateways, forge, cybernetics core, stargate, cannon and battery. Probes warp buildings in; they need a pylon's power field. Shields come back after a fight.
Under the base lie ancient temples with shrines. Zealots guard every lone pylon in the wild; dark templars hide in caves.
